page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-360-lssd is a memory-optimized and storage-intensive server instance powered by the AMD EPYC 9B14 processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 360 virtual CPUs mapped to 180 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The hardware configuration includes 2880.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance is equipped with 12864 GB of NVMe SSD capacity distributed across 32 local drives, with no integrated GPU accelerators.

Benchmark results place this instance in the top tier for multi-core CPU performance, passmark CPU scores, and memory bandwidth across both small and large block read/write operations. It achieves top-tier performance in specialized workloads, including Redis SET operations, static web serving throughput, and software compilation. Cryptographic and vector instruction capabilities are supported via AVX-512 and VAES flags. While prompt processing for small, medium, and large language models ranks in the top tier, text generation speeds range from average to strong, reflecting a relative tradeoff between raw throughput and sequential generation latency.

Given its massive memory footprint and high-density local NVMe storage, this instance offers high resource density for enterprise-scale workloads. The qualitative cost profile reflects a premium hardware class designed to consolidate large-scale databases, in-memory data stores, and heavy ETL pipelines. It is highly suited for memory-intensive database operations, large-scale software compilation, and high-throughput web serving, where the combination of 2880 GB of RAM and 12.8 TB of local NVMe SSDs can be fully utilized.
